message.content:
Hanoi’s weather varies quite a bit throughout the year:

| Season | Typical Weather |
|--------|-----------------|
| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | Cool and dry, temperatures ranging from 12 °C to 20 °C (54 °F to 68 °F). Occasional cold fronts can bring brief frosts. |
| **Spring (Mar–Apr)** | Warm and humid, temperatures around 18 °C to 28 °C (64 °F to 82 °F). Rainfall starts increasing toward late April. |
| **Summer (May–Jun)** | Hot and very humid, temperatures often above 30 °C (86 °F) with high humidity. May is usually the hottest month. |
| **Monsoon (Jul–Aug)** | Heavy rainfall, temperatures 25 °C to 32 °C (77 °F to 90 °F). Expect frequent afternoon showers or thunderstorms. |
| **Autumn (Sep–Oct)** | Cooler and drier, temperatures 20 °C to 27 °C (68 °F to 81 °F). September can still see some rain, but October is typically sunny. |

If you’re planning a visit, it’s best to check a reliable local forecast closer to your travel dates for up‑to‑date details.
